mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 4.0%) signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 4.0% in 60% or more of instances where the 20-day forward return is negative, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases the cost of capital and reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS above 4.5% in 60% or more of instances where the 5-day forward return is positive, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate and decline in employment growth signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE rising and PAYEMS falling does not produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery regime (HOUST above 1250 thousand units and RSAFS above 700,000 million dollars), rising housing starts and retail sales signal strong consumer demand that boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the regime where HOUST > 1250 and RSAFS > 700000, the 60-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals strong manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO above 100 in 60% or more of instances where the 20-day forward return is negative, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1200 thousand units signal weak residential construction that reduces consumer confidence and corporate capital expenditure, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST below 1200 in 60% or more of instances where the 5-day forward return is positive, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 4.5% signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE above 4.5% in 60% or more of instances where the 20-day forward return is positive, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 320) and a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of CPIAUCSL > 320 and FEDFUNDS > 4.0% does not produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.
